title: After-Hours TRO Application
summary: Helping a DV victim get a temporary restraining order when the court is closed.

steps.text: Confirm the DV relationship and a predicate act
Check the DV registry for existing orders and prior history
Explain the TRO process neutrally; don't discourage or promise outcomes
Ask what relief the victim wants: no contact, residence, custody, places to stay away from
Ask about weapons and firearms the defendant has access to
Complete the TRO application with the victim's account in their own words
Contact the on-call judge per your court's procedure; the victim gives sworn testimony
Record the time the TRO is granted and the judge's name
Give the victim a copy and the final hearing date and location
Serve the defendant as soon as possible
Seize weapons and permits as the order directs
Enter the order and service in the registry; complete reports
Give the victim safety planning and hotline information

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
